decisions.reason: A portable reference-class electrometer builds directly on the firm's core dosimetry and measurement know-how, so the firm can read early market feedback well, improve the product through its own R&D, and it was featured on the home page, which signals strategic priority.

Oncology risk-management software is further from the firm's hardware base but draws on its deep knowledge of radiotherapy workflows and clinical customers; it has a dedicated page and complements the QA portfolio, so management will keep developing it rather than drop it after one year.
